Uncalibrated heuristic: a normalised relative score, not a probability, and no measured operating point. A clean result is NOT evidence that the document is genuine - verify independently.

On-device camera HAL inspection against virtual drivers, memory hooks and emulator injection. The score is a RELATIVE indicator score, not a probability, and it is not calibrated: a flagged session is a signal to REVIEW, not a basis for an automatic rejection. Finding nothing is not proof of a genuine device. Complete regulatory compliance requires server-side attestation.
